$comment: Copy to src/data/site.json. origin is the production URL (astro.config `site` wins when set). themeColor is only the no-JS fallback: ThemeInit overwrites it with --color-bg. Leave twitter.site as the placeholder, or empty, to omit twitter:site. defaultOgImage must be a real 1200x630 PNG/JPG/WebP in public/.
tagline: One line that says what this site is for.
defaultDescription: A single sentence, roughly 120 to 160 characters, that describes the site for search results and link previews.
